title: Wood Firing Workshop - Fall 2026
source_quote:
Wood Firing Workshop - Fall 2026
September 13th - October 24th
This five week hands-on session will introduce participants about kiln loading, firing techniques, and the unique surface effects that come from wood ash and flame.
evidence_sentence: This five-week workshop introduces participants to kiln loading, firing techniques, and wood ash effects by making and firing their own pieces.
evidence_quote: This five week hands-on session will introduce participants about kiln loading, firing techniques, and the unique surface effects that come from wood ash and flame. Students will also make their own pieces to fire in the kiln with instructors demonstrating forms that they have found to be successful in wood fire.
summary: Five-week hands-on wood firing workshop (September 13–October 24, 2026) where students make pieces to fire in the kiln and learn firing techniques and wood ash surface effects.
bring: Participants make their own pieces to fire
